Minichart","url":"https://www.minichart.com.sg/2026/11/05/vitrox-q3-fy2026-net-profit-triples-to-rm118-6-million-on-record-rm485-1-million-revenue/","publishedDate":"2026-11-05T00:00:00.000Z","text":"ViTrox Q3 FY2026 Net Profit Triples to RM118.6 Million on Record RM485.1 Million Revenue – Minichart\n\n# ViTrox Q3 FY2026 Net Profit Triples to RM118.6 Million on Record RM485.1 Million Revenue\n\nPosted on November 5, 2026 at 5:50 pm (GMT+8)\n\n \n\nViTrox Corporation Berhad (Bursa: VITROX, 0097) reported a record quarterly performance, with third-quarter FY2026 revenue surging 112.2% year-on-year to RM485.1 million and net profit attributable to owners rising 241.6% to RM118.6 million. The results, announced on 5 November 2026 for the financial period ended 30 September 2026, were driven by strong demand for AI infrastructure and networking equipment inspection solutions across its Automated Board Inspection (ABI) and Machine Vision System (MVS) segments.\n\n## Financial Highlights\n\n| Metric (RM’000 unless stated) | Q3 FY2026 | Q3 FY2025 | Change | 9M FY2026 | 9M FY2025 | Change |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Revenue | 485,101 | 228,567 | +112.2% | 1,127,067 | 552,728 | +103.9% |\n| Profit before tax | 136,774 | 50,464 | +171.0% | 298,379 | 115,784 | +157.7% |\n| Net profit attributable to owners | 118,580 | 34,716 | +241.6% | 254,821 | 87,009 | +192.9% |\n| Basic EPS (sen) | 6.26 | 1.83 | +242.1% | 13.45 | 4.60 | +192.4% |\n| PBT margin | ~28.2% | ~22.1% | +6.1 pp | ~26.5% | ~20.9% | +5.6 pp |\n| Dividend per share (sen) | 0.00 | 1.18 | n.m. | 0.70 | n.a. | n.a. |\n\nNote: PBT margin computed from disclosed figures. 9M FY2026 dividend per share reflects dividends declared for the period. Q3 FY2025 comparative dividend of 1.18 sen was a final dividend for FY2025 paid in July 2026. No dividend was declared in Q3 FY2026.\n\nOn a sequential basis, revenue rose 29.4% from RM374.9 million in Q2 FY2026, while profit before tax grew 36.8% to RM136.8 million. Net profit attributable to owners increased 39.4% quarter-on-quarter to RM118.6 million.\n\nThe company said growth was primarily driven by strong demand across its ABI and MVS segments, supported by expanded adoption of advanced inspection solutions for AI infrastructure and networking equipment. Manufacturing economies of scale and a favourable product mix lifted PBT, while a lower effective tax rate—due to tax incentives enjoyed by wholly-owned subsidiary ViTrox Technologies Sdn Bhd (VTSB)—boosted net profit. VTSB holds a five-year income tax exemption, extendable for a further five years, for activities related to 4D advanced industrial automation systems for semiconductor advanced packaging and AI smart factories.\n\n### Cash Flow and Balance Sheet\n\nDespite the strong profit, the group reported net cash used in operating activities of RM8.5 million for 9M FY2026, compared with net cash from operating activities of RM101.5 million a year earlier. Operating profit before working capital changes rose to RM305.5 million from RM122.4 million, but working capital absorbed cash as inventories increased by RM231.8 million and receivables rose by RM304.1 million. Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment amounted to RM63.6 million versus RM23.2 million previously. Cash and cash equivalents declined to RM283.9 million at 30 September 2026 from RM409.2 million at 31 December 2025.\n\nTotal term loans stood at RM77.1 million (USD18.9 million) at end-September 2026, down from RM101.7 million (USD24.1 million) a year earlier. The higher prior-year balance reflected an additional term loan drawn to finance construction of Campus 3.0 in Batu Kawan. Effective interest rates for term loans ranged from 4.77% to 4.83%, compared with 5.19% to 5.34% previously. Net assets per share rose to RM0.7230 from RM0.5981 at 31 December 2025.\n\n### Dividends\n\nNo dividend was proposed or declared in the current quarter. During the nine-month period, the company paid an interim tax-exempt dividend of 0.63 sen per share (RM11.9 million) for FY2025 on 16 January 2026 and a final tax-exempt dividend of 1.18 sen per share (RM22.4 million) for FY2025 on 15 July 2026. Total dividends paid in 9M FY2026 amounted to RM34.3 million versus RM22.7 million a year earlier.\n\n### Outlook\n\nViTrox anticipates a favourable business environment for the remainder of FY2026 and into 2027, citing hyperscaler spending projected at US$754 billion in 2026 and US$1.11 trillion in 2027. Gartner forecasts worldwide semiconductor revenue to grow 92% to US$1.6 trillion in 2026 and reach US$1.9 trillion in 2027, while SEMI projects global semiconductor equipment sales of US$165.9 billion in 2026, up 23.2%. The group continues to position its advanced packaging and high-precision inspection solutions for AI accelerators and High Bandwidth Memory, and is developing next-generation high-resolution machine vision solutions.\n\nThe company flagged risks from foreign exchange volatility and geopolitical uncertainties, and noted that its operations are dependent on the cyclical semiconductor and electronics industries. It said it will maintain prudent cost management and operational discipline.\n\n## What Investors Should Wat","highlights":["# ViTrox Q3 FY2026 Net Profit Triples to RM118.6 Million on Record RM485.1 Million Revenue\n\nPosted on November 5, 2026 at 5:50 pm (GMT+8)\n\n \n\nViTrox Corporation Berhad (Bursa: VITROX, 0097) reported a record quarterly performance, with third-quarter FY2026 revenue surging 112.2% year-on-year to RM485.1 million and net profit attributable to owners rising 241.6% to RM118.6 million. The company's latest outlook paints an optimistic picture for 2026, driven by explosive demand for artificial intelligence (AI), massive investments in data centres, and a sharp recovery in the chip memory market. A Golden Era for the Semiconductor Industry According to Gartner, the global semiconductor market is expected to expand by an astonishing 64% in 2026, surpassing US$1.3 trillion in annual revenue. Several powerful growth drivers are supporting this expansion: AI is becoming the industry's biggest growth engine. AI-related semiconductors are expected to contribute around 30% of total semiconductor revenue. Memory chip prices are experiencing a strong recovery, boosting industry revenue. Demand continues to accelerate as cloud computing and AI applications become increasingly widespread. These structural trends are expected to create long-term opportunities across the semiconductor value chain. Hyperscalers Continue to Spend Aggressively Global technology giants are showing no signs of slowing their AI investments. ViTrox highlighted that hyperscaler spending on AI infrastructure is projected to increase by more than 50%, driving demand for: High-performance GPUs AI accelerators Specialised non-GPU processors Advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies As semiconductor complexity increases, manufacturers require increasingly sophisticated inspection equipment to maintain quality and yield. Advanced Packaging: ViTrox's Next Growth Engine One of the most exciting opportunities lies in advanced semiconductor packaging. As chips become smaller, more powerful and more complex, manufacturers require: Ultra-high inspection accuracy Higher-resolution imaging More precise defect detection Faster production inspection This is precisely where ViTrox sees significant growth potential. QX1 Series: Designed for the Next Generation of Chip Manufacturing To capture this expanding market, ViTrox has introduced its new QX1 Series. The new platform is designed to provide: Ultra-high-resolution 3D X-ray inspection Inspection of miniature and highly complex components Advanced packaging applications Electronics assembly inspection The QX1 Series strengthens ViTrox's product portfolio and positions the company to benefit from the industry's migration toward increasingly advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies. Growth with Financial Discipline Despite the favourable industry outlook, ViTrox remains disciplined in its execution. Management continues to focus on: Proactive cost management Operational efficiency Protecting profit margins Managing currency volatility Navigating geopolitical uncertainties This balanced strategy allows the company to pursue growth opportunities while maintaining financial resilience. Key Takeaways for Investors ViTrox's 2026 outlook highlights several important themes: The semiconductor industry is entering a powerful expansion cycle. AI is becoming the primary driver of industry growth. The global semiconductor market is projected to exceed US$1.3 trillion. Hyperscaler AI spending is expected to rise by more than 50%. Advanced packaging is emerging as one of the industry's fastest-growing segments. ViTrox's new QX1 Series is strategically positioned to capitalise on this trend. Cost discipline and prudent operational management remain priorities despite the optimistic outlook. Conclusion While short-term market sentiment may continue to fluctuate due to geopolitical developments, currency movements and macroeconomic uncertainty, ViTrox's long-term growth story remains firmly supported by structural industry trends. 374,915 \n\n 183,043 \n\n 191,872 \n\n 104.8% \n\n Profit before tax \n\n 99,946 \n\n 37,907 \n\n 62,039 \n\n 163.7% \n\n Profit for the financial period \n\n 84,495 \n\n 27,807 \n\n 56,688 \n\n 203.9% \n\n Profit attributable to owners of \n\n the Company \n\n 85,043 \n\n 28,133 \n\n 56,910 \n\n 202.3% \n\n The Group's revenue for the quarter under review achieved a stellar expansion of 104.8% or RM191.9 million, surging from RM183.0 million in the corresponding preceding quarter to RM374.9 million. This remarkable top-line performance was primarily driven by explosive Artificial Intelligence (\"AI\") infrastructure demand, our strategic focus into high-value, resilient markets like automotive, and consumer electronics and accelerated global supply chain restructuring which has deepened customer engagements. Our focus on advanced packaging and high-precision inspection solutions directly addresses the increasing complexities of AI accelerators and High Bandwidth Memory (\"HBM\") mirroring the strong momentum seen in the broader semiconductors and electronics manufacturing sector and enabling us to expand our output far beyond the previous year's low baseline. \n\n Profit before tax (\"PBT\") for the individual quarter surged by 163.7% or RM62.0 million, soaring to RM99.9 million from RM37.9 million due to structural manufacturing scale and a highly favourable product mix. Profit after tax (\"PAT\") rose by 203.9% or RM56.7 million, increasing from RM27.8 million to RM84.5 million. This bottom-line outperformance reflects exceptional operational optimization across the facilities alongside the sustained positive impact of income tax exemption enjoyed by the key subsidiary ViTrox Technologies Sdn. Bhd. (\"VTSB\")."],"summary":"Summary:\n\n- ViTrox Corporation Berhad (Malaysia) released its interim financial report for the second quarter ended 30 June 2026.\n- Key Q2 2026 highlights:\n  - Revenue: RM 374.9 million in the current quarter, up 104.8% vs. RM 183.0 million in the prior-year quarter.\n  - Profit before tax: RM 99.95 million, up from RM 37.91 million.\n  - Profit for the financial period: RM 84.50 million, up from RM 27.81 million.\n  - Earnings per share (basic): 4.49 sen (diluted: 4.46 sen).\n  - Comprehensive income for the period: RM 85.20 million (owners of the company), with strong currency translation impact.\n- Cumulative H1 2026 (period-to-date to 30 Jun 2026) performance shows substantial growth vs. the previous year (Revenue RM 641.97 million; Profit before tax RM 161.61 million; Profit for the period RM 135.28 million).\n- The report is unaudited and prepared under MFRS 134 interim reporting guidelines; readers should interpret alongside the 2025 annual audited statements and accompanying notes.\n- The document includes standard statements of financial position, changes in equity, cash flows, and notes (not all figures shown in summary).\n\nIf you want, I can pull out specific figures (e.g., total assets, equity, cash flows) or compare against Bursa Malaysia expectations.","image":"https://www.marketscreener.com/images/twitter_MS_fdblanc.png"}],"searchTime":6113.3,"costDollars":{"total":0.012,"search":{"neural":0.007},"summary":0.005},"warnings":[{"code":"IGNORED_FIELD","path":"/contents/highlights/highlightsPerUrl","message":"contents.highlights.highlightsPerUrl is no longer supported and is ignored.
